Create ONE original sharp realistic premium editorial haircut photograph, NOT a collage, contact sheet, sprite or illustration. The person is a fictional ADULT. HEAD AND SHOULDERS only: complete top of head, all main hair edges, ears and entire haircut silhouette visible, with clear breathing room above the crown and generous margin at both sides. No close crop, no torso emphasis. LOOSE OPAQUE HIGH TURTLENECK LONG-SLEEVED jumper covers neckline and all upper chest, with generous fabric so no chest or torso contour; no low cut, open collar, sleeveless outfit or exposed upper chest. Plain light ivory studio; neutral daylight, sharp face and ALL hair detail, sufficient depth of field; no deliberate blur, bokeh, grain, fog or defocus filter. Natural skin texture, restrained premium salon colour. No text, logos, watermark, jewellery, celebrity likeness, stock or competitor reference. Preserve full source aspect. Render at genuine original native resolution supported by this tool, preferably at least1024pixels long edge. No enlargement or upscaling. a fictional adult Middle Eastern woman with olive skin and dark eyes, age 61, wearing a loose opaque ivory HIGH TURTLENECK long-sleeved jumper with very loose fabric covering upper chest completely. Create one original editorial photograph of a fictional adult with a true bob-pixie hybrid. Primary collection: Classic bixie haircuts. Design: lightly tousled | short graduated | wispy | ear-revealing temple pieces | 0-crown-to-front-proportion. Attributes: {"texture": "curly", "strand": "medium", "density": "medium", "length": "medium", "fringe": "wispy", "colour": "blonde", "finish": "natural", "age_reference": "adult", "face_reference": "unspecified", "maintenance": "discuss"}. Fully covered modest outfit, closed high neckline, long sleeves, no exposed shoulders, chest or back. Portrait 4:5, no words, watermark or logos. Do not substitute an ordinary bob, close pixie or long wolf cut. Render a clearly distinct haircut concept rather than only changing colour or model age. FRONT view: face directly forward and level, both eyes and full front haircut outline visible, no three-quarter turn. Quiet natural expression. Hair/cut attributes in this brief are authoritative; clothing rule is high loose opaque turtleneck.
FULL FRAMING: head and shoulder line only, full sharp hair silhouette surrounded by background margin. Loose opaque oversized tall ivory turtleneck, no neckline/chest/shoulder exposure, no body contours. All hair sharp with no deliberate blur.
CUT STRUCTURE: true bob-pixie hybrid with longer ear-level side shape and a distinctly shorter graduated or tapered nape as specified; never a full bob. 
AUTHORITATIVE TEXTURE OVERRIDE: truly CURLY blonde hair with numerous clearly defined spiralling ringlets 1 cm in diameter from roots to ends, distinct circular curl loops and ringlets over crown, temples and wispy fringe. NOT loose waves, NOT merely bent straight strands. Lightly tousled curly medium bixie with longer ear-level ringlet side pieces and short graduated nape.
